# Jayamahesh Ayurveda & Wellness Clinic

> Classical Kerala Ayurvedic healing sanctuary and specialized clinical outpatient center in Parassala, Kerala, India.

Jayamahesh Ayurveda & Wellness Clinic (JMAWC) provides authentic classical Ayurvedic medicine rooted in the centuries-old Kerala Vaidya tradition. Guided by Chief Physician Dr. Jayalekshmi (M.D, B.A.M.S) and experienced classical practitioners, the clinic specializes in diagnostic pulse reading (Nadi Pariksha), Panchakarma therapies, and customized herbal decoctions prepared in traditional copper vessels using organic sesame, coconut oil, and wildcrafted botanicals.

## Medical Leadership & Practitioners
- **Dr. Jayalekshmi (M.D, B.A.M.S)**: Chief Ayurvedic Physician & Vaidya. Clinical diagnostician specializing in classical Nadi Pariksha (radial pulse diagnosis), chronic disease reversal, and individualized botanical formulation.
- **Maya**: Senior Classical Ayurvedic Therapist. Specialist in rhythmic Shirodhara forehead streaming, cranial Marma massage, and synchronized Abhyangam.
- **Rajalekshmi**: Senior Classical Ayurvedic Practitioner. Specialist in Pizhichil warm oil streaming, Kizhi herbal poultice compress, and Kadivasthi spinal pools.

## Classical Therapeutic Treatments Offered
- [Pizhichil (The Royal Oil Stream)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Continuous warm streams of medicated herbal oils rhythmically massaged over the body. Indicated for arthritis, hemiplegia, neurological rejuvenation, and physical exhaustion.
- [Shirodhara (Continuous Meditative Oil Stream)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Steady, pendulum stream of warm herbal oil or decoction over the forehead (Ajna / third eye chakra). Indicated for chronic insomnia, anxiety, migraines, hypertension, and cognitive fatigue.
- [Abhyangam (Synchronized Herbal Body Massage)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Full-body synchronized oleation therapy using dosha-specific botanical oils. Indicated for musculoskeletal stiffness, circulation enhancement, and lymphatic drainage.
- [Kizhi (Warm Botanical Bolus Therapy)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Heated herbal leaves (Ela Kizhi) or medicinal herbal powders (Podi Kizhi) tied in muslin poultices and applied with warm oil. Indicated for sciatica, lumbar spondylosis, muscle cramps, and joint swelling.
- [Kadivasthi (Lumbar Oil Dam Therapy)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Warm medicated oil pooled inside a herbal black gram dough reservoir over the lower spine. Indicated for disc prolapse, degenerative spine disease, and chronic lumbago.
- [Shirovasthi (Cranial Medicated Oil Reservoir)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Medicated oils retained inside an elongated cylindrical leather cap placed on the scalp. Indicated for facial palsy, severe headaches, insomnia, and trigeminal neuralgia.
- [Dhara (Takradhara & Ksheeradhara)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Continuous streams of medicinal buttermilk (Takra) or herb-infused milk (Ksheera) over the forehead or entire body. Indicated for Pitta disorders, skin conditions, and mental overheating.
- [Nadi Pariksha (Pulse Reading & Consultation)](https://jayamahesh.web.app/#studio): Classical radial pulse diagnosis to assess Vata, Pitta, and Kapha constitutional imbalances and cellular vitality.
